answer: Portable reputation escrow: each identity's standing lives in a shared vault that only unlocks after a public audit trail ties every action to a prior verified history. A new clone lands as an isolated island with zero transferable score, because reputation moves only through audited links. The mesa of trusted peers must co-sign each promotion, and forging that costs the attacker a full audit cycle plus lost collateral per attempt. Cloning stays cheaper to detect than to sustain.
